scope: Free tube spans between35mm grips; ideal fixed roots and rigid common motor node. E/G and friction coefficients are sensitivities,not identified CFK data. Equivalent-isotropic beam stress is not a laminate failure criterion. No global-frame/node compliance,contact solution,bolt prying,buckling,fatigue or landing shock.
clamp_model: Required friction normal force=sqrt(axial_force²+(tube_torsion/radius)²)/mu. Bearing-pressure screen=Ftrans/(D*L)+6*Mb/(D*L²),linear projected-contact approximation; not contact FEA and not an allowable.
proof_needed: Clamp pressure/slip tests with actual PU/isolation
Al node FEA,global frame,foot rails,indexing and fatigue
Dynamic modes and loaded rotor clearances
